findings.detail: Description of "agent_input_firewall" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "agent_input_firewall" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
